label: 雷电将军 · 模型适配

retarget.method: Original mesh proportions preserved by a single uniform transform; independent source-length display skeleton follows original AMB/POS rotations; display weapon sockets follow the new hands.
retarget.fingerArticulation: Thumb and index chains of the native rig drive the source finger groups; other fingers fold into those two chains.

provenance.credit: 模型提供：miHoYo；模型改造：观海（BiliBili：观海子）。
provenance.license: Original distribution readme retained verbatim. It forbids redistribution, part extraction and commercial use, and states MMD use; this is a user-requested local adaptation, not a rights grant or published distribution.
limits: Original source proportions preserved; action retarget remains approximate.
Source PMX has no verified real-world centimetre calibration; no physical height is claimed.
Source hair skeleton and weights retained but MMD rigid bodies are not executed.
Skirt panels are rigid on the pelvis and the sleeves ride their source arm bones; no cloth solver.
No expression morph or independent per-finger solver.
Original toon ramp and sphere maps are not reproduced; base colour, alpha cutout and roughness are used.
